title: Bring Your Own Data! Self-Supervised Evaluation of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes a general framework for self-supervised evaluation of LLMs on metrics like closed-book knowledge, toxicity, long-range context dependence, grammatical structure sensitivity, and tokenization errors.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
